_source: Five Parsecs: Tactics p.165 (Clones (The Many) profiles and Special Rules). Units are composed from data/tactics/army_builder.json (pp.133-139); weapons come from data/tactics/tactics_weapons_master.json (p.181)
_book_notes: p.165 prints Savvy and Training as "x": One Mind sets them. Stored at the baseline the rule gives "in all other circumstances" (+1 Savvy, +1 Training); a major character present makes it +1/+2, an epic +2/+2

species.description: Mass-produced soldiers. Expendable and easily replaced, Clone forces overwhelm through sheer numbers and rapid deployment.

traits.name: One Mind
traits.description: If an epic character clone is present on the battlefield, all clones have +2 Savvy and +2 Training. If a major character is present, they have +1 Savvy, +2 Training. In all other circumstances they have +1 Savvy and +1 Training.

traits.name: Group Tactics
traits.description: When taking Morale tests, take all your required Morale tests on clone units by first counting how many KP of figures are scheduled for removal due to failed tests. You must then remove that number of clone KP, but may do so from any clone units you like. For example, if a clone squad with 3 figures (1 KP each) fails a Morale test, remove 3 KP of clones from any units you like.
